thread:
Maya (Support): FYI customer NW Labs — outgoing USD wire returned by correspondent. Bank note: 'Beneficiary bank BIC not matched: unexpected suffix'. Need quick triage.

Liam (Payments): Can you paste the raw wire payload we sent? Could be a formatting issue (trailing space / padding).

Maya (Support): Here is the payload we received from the customer import and what we sent: 
```
{
  "amount": "5000.00",
  "currency": "USD",
  "beneficiary_name": "NW Labs",
  "account": "1234567890",
  "routing_aba": "021000021",
  "bic": "BOFAUS3NXXX "
}
```
Notice the BIC has a trailing space in our transmitted payload.

Carlos (Settlement Ops): That trailing space will definitely break strict BIC matching at some correspondents. Some chain nodes truncate/pad differently and will treat "BOFAUS3NXXX " as not matching expected "BOFAUS3NXXX". Did the bank include an expected BIC in the return notes?

Maya (Support): Bank log says expected: BOFAUS3NXXX (no trailing space). Intermediary says they matched to BOFAUS3N but couldn't resolve the full 11-char code. Customer import came from CSV.

Liam (Payments): Sounds like our CSV ingestion left a non-breaking-space or similar char. There's a known edge case where we strip normal whitespace but not NBSP (U+00A0) in older normalizer versions. @ach-bot show deploys for payments-normalizer around the transaction time.

ach-bot: deploy 2026-02-18T15:40Z payments-normalizer v2.7.4 -> v2.7.5 rolled, no active alerts.

Etta (Customer Success): Customer is asking for repro steps and ETA to get funds re-sent. Can we do a manual resend quickly?

Liam (Payments): Short-term: manual resend with cleaned BIC and explicit intermediary_bic. I can do that once support confirms it's okay to re-initiate. Also will add a one-off flag to force 11-char padding.

Maya (Support): Please resend. Customer approves.

Liam (Payments): Resending now. Command used: 
```
/payments resend --tx 0x9f8b --set bic=BOFAUS3NXXX --intermediary_bic=CHASUS33XXX --force-bic-pad=true
```

Carlos (Settlement Ops): Noted — recon team flagged the original return. Will watch for settlement events and match to the new TX.

Maya (Support): Update from customer bank: resubmission accepted and funds posted at 2026-02-18 17:02 UTC.

Etta (Customer Success): I'll confirm with NW Labs and close the ticket once they verify receipt. :white_check_mark:

Liam (Payments): Action items: 1) I'll PR a validator to reject non-ASCII whitespace in BIC fields + add unit tests, 2) Add regression test for CSV ingestion edge case, 3) Add a transform to normalize/pad to 8/11 chars as appropriate.

Carlos (Settlement Ops): I'll add a reconciliation alert so returns with "BIC mismatch" get higher signal.

Maya (Support): Thanks all — closing thread after Etta confirms with customer.
